text:
lisa_finance: Quick flag  finance reviewed BatchOps term sheet and found several billing items we should push back on before pilot.

omar_procure: Which items in particular?

lisa_finance: Short list: (1) "price experiments" clause allowing +/-15% changes on pricing with 30d notice; (2) invoice in USD routed to EU bank entity (FX exposure); (3) one-time onboarding fee $15k non-refundable; (4) lack of line-item invoice details for embedding vs GPU.

sarah_ops: Price experiments is a no-go for us. That could change embedding rates mid-pilot.

henry_legal: We should require any price increase to be mutual for first 12 months or give us a termination right for material increases >5%. Also ask to define "price experiment" scope and limits.

lisa_finance: For FX: request invoicing in our billing currency (USD) to US entity or add fixed FX rate protection for 12 months. Net-30 preferred (their terms say Net-45).

omar_procure: I'll ask for Net-30 and an early-pay discount option instead of longer net. Also propose onboarding fee be credited if usage hits Tier B within 90 days.

devon_sales: Vendor indicated onboarding covers SSO + VPC setup. They may convert to usage credit if we hit commit. We can make that conditional.

sarah_ops: Operational asks: we need monthly CSV export + API for usage, and a sample invoice template. Billing must map to SKUs: vGPU-hours, embedding-vector-hours, storage, network.

henry_legal: Add SLA credit mechanics: credits applied to next invoice line items automatically, with clear measurement and reporting on downtime.

lisa_finance: Also require quarterly audit rights to reconcile vector-hour counts vs our telemetry; if discrepancy >2% vendor adjusts invoice.

omar_procure: I'll bundle these into a redline and send to BatchOps by EOD tomorrow. Procurement_bot: tag vendor-contract and set milestone 2024-07-01.

procurement_bot: Tagged vendor-contract. Reminder: upload term sheet and sample invoices.

devon_sales: Suggest offering a pilot PO capped at $30k with an opt-in overage switch and a console cap to prevent surprise billing. That usually moves vendors faster.

sarah_ops: Agreed  require a dashboard toggle to disable overages beyond the PO cap.

lisa_finance: OK team: Omar will draft the asks; Henry will prepare contract language for price protection and SLA credits; Sarah will list required telemetry fields; Devon will request the sample invoice and usage-API details. We target sending vendor the consolidated ask set tomorrow.

omar_procure: On it  will circulate a draft in ~3 hours.

lisa_finance: Thanks everyone. Let's lock the pilot protection before we sign anything. :thumbsup:
